102.lookup_query: SELECT ard.{key_column} FROM TAB_NEO_CAS_LMS.LMS_ASSET_REPOSSESSION_DTL ard INNER JOIN (SELECT ID FROM TAB_NEO_CAS_LMS.LMS_ASSET_REPOSSESSION_HDR WHERE CREATION_TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('{lookback_timestamp}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') OR LAST_UPDATED_TIME_STAMP >= TO_DATE('{lookback_timestamp}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) arh ON arh.ID = ard.ASSET_REPO_HDRID FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY
